title: parameter names do not distinguish same-type signatures
purpose: An overload is its name, arity, parameter types and variadic shape; two actions differing only in parameter names are the same signature.

failure.justification: A declaration-level rule checked after parsing; an implementation may also detect it at registration/runtime. The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: migrated by #1005: one overload identity for actions and constructors
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.8 (#1005): parameter names and result types do not distinguish overloads.
